delivery.outcome: Publish the already merged atomic material-delivery fix as one immutable new-project 0.19.0 standard revision so adopters can use its corrected validator.
nonGoals: Do not change the merged policy semantics
Do not publish from an unmerged feature head
Do not move runtime ownership into wellmanifest

architecture.decision: Synchronize the declared standard version, its manifests and conformance fixtures, then release only after the full hub test contract passes on the reviewed main-derived PR.
architecture.rollback: Do not move the immutable tag; publish a later corrective version if release verification fails.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
validation.evidence: The complete deterministic hub contract passes before publication.
